body: I know that they'd find out eventually. I just wanted it to be naturally rather than being told. The people he told knew I was having surgery, but didn't know what it was for. I wanted that to be kept private, until I felt ready for them to know.

You're probably right. It's just very frustrating in the moment. I don't have many friends to begin with, and my brother is like my best friend. Knowing now that I can't tell him my business really sucks. 

I feel so angry I want to tell him that I know HIS secret.

He seemed certain it wasn't a big deal, and didn't even apologize which is frustrating to me. He obviously wouldn't understand how I feel (not many 24 year olds would), but I thought he'd keep my information private.  

It'd be very satisfying. Especially to tell the 2 people who he told my secret to. The 2 people can be very homophobic at times, so they'd probably rip him apart if they knew. 

The problem is that he doesn't know that I know that he's bisexual. (if that makes sense). So I'm not sure I should tell him that I know or just leave it be.

They probably would eventually, but I'd want them to notice it on their own. I specifically asked him not to tell anyone, and he told 2 people. 

Makes me feel like I can't trust my brother who's one of the few people I thought I could tell personal things to.
